subject: Harborline Capital: our 2026 annual letter
body:
Dear founders and friends,

This year we backed 14 new companies and saw three of our earliest bets reach profitability. Our annual letter covers what we got wrong about AI infrastructure and where we expect seed rounds to go next year.

Warmly,
Harborline Capital
